propositions: Recursive fixture teardown using Path.rglob traverses unrelated mutable subtrees including live canonical store lock directories that vanish during traversal, causing FileNotFoundError on Python 3.11 but not 3.12 due to pathlib caching semantics.

The shared teardown fixture _remove_readonly_run_snapshots must discover snapshot roots at arbitrary depth while tolerating concurrent directory disappearance and preserving non-snapshot content without changing async workflow semantics or store lock lifecycle.
Replacing Path.rglob with os.walk and filtering only FileNotFoundError (not PermissionError) in the error handler eliminates the race while maintaining exact-root snapshot cleanup coverage.

Ambient Path factory calls in test teardown fixtures raise NotImplementedError on Python 3.11 when os.name is monkeypatched to 'nt' before fixture restoration, requiring concrete path type selection via tmp_path parent class rather than generic Path().
